judge.rationale: The candidate ignored the explicit message and type names in the issue (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`), inventing `list_sessions` and `session_list` instead. It also directly violated the requirement to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error when a store has no `listFor` (returning an empty `sessions: []` array instead) and completely omitted the `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag (serving the list unconditionally). In `validation.ts`, it allows `limit: 0` and unbounded limits (`limit > 200`), contrary to the 1–200 specification. Furthermore, it logged raw store error messages (which the spec warns can leak connection strings) rather than error types, omitted `StoreCannotList`, and skipped updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
